Bettina, I've saved the mail as a draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It hasn't been sent. I also posted a reply in the #coastal-team thread.

The draft uses Sofia's bullets and now says the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments and the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. It ends by asking June which saved reports still use the old name or the bare "PHL" label, and who should update them.

It's signed as you, so check it before you send it.
